paragraphs.text: Meaning, the description of the land.
paragraphs.label: a
paragraphs.anchor: land that shall fall unto you

paragraphs.text: Which was Nilus, or as some think Rhinocotura.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Which is a mountain near Tyre and Sidon, and not that Hor in the wilderness where Aaron died.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Which in the Gospel is called the lake of Gennesaret.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: One of the heads or chief men of every tribe.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: And be judges over every piece of ground that should fall to any by lot, to the intent that all things might be done orderly and without contention.
paragraphs.label: g
paragraphs.anchor: divide the inheritance unto the children
